name: life-dew
flavor_text: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
effect_text_extend: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
effect_text_simple: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
